purpose: Measure the answer-quality effect of limiting differently worded nodes that cite the same exact evidence set, using the frozen accepted BEAM dev5 pack and otherwise identical answer and judge protocol

answerer.digest_scope: The digest pins the local Ollama cloud manifest; Ollama does not expose an immutable remote weight revision.

judge.digest_scope: The digest pins the local Ollama cloud manifest; Ollama does not expose an immutable remote weight revision.

hypothesis: One ranked node per exact evidence set will expose more distinct source events within the same top-50 budget and improve or preserve answer quality relative to the frozen dev5 baseline.

evaluation.primary: paired pass transitions at the 0.5 question threshold
evaluation.secondary: mean rubric score delta and per-category scores
evaluation.promotion_rule: Do not make the broader cap a default from this tuned development cohort. Treat a positive result as evidence for an opt-in control and require a separately registered untouched confirmation before any default change.
evaluation.failure_rule: Retain all regressions. Any pass-level loss or negative mean delta blocks a default change and narrows follow-up analysis to the observed failure types.
evaluation.stop_rule: Run all 20 fixed questions once. Resume only from saved per-question checkpoints after infrastructure failure; do not change retrieval or model settings after viewing outcomes.

claim_boundary: This is a paired, tuned one-conversation development ablation over an already examined frozen pack. It can isolate the observed effect of max_per_evidence=1 under this protocol, but it is not an untouched confirmation, official-scale BEAM result, or evidence of market leadership.
